title: Aritificial Intelligence (AI) - Chatbots
description: This course dives into the architecture, design, and implementation of conversational bots. You’ll explore industry use cases, map out conversational flows, and examine the technology stacks behind leading platforms such as Dialogflow, Alexa Skills Kit, and Chatfuel. Through hands-on labs, you’ll build serverless functions with AWS Lambda, design advanced conversational memory with contexts and follow-up intents, and deploy bots across web, mobile, and voice channels.
shortDescription: Learn to architect, develop, and deploy chatbots using Dialogflow, AWS Lambda, Alexa Skills Kit, and Chatfuel with real-world use cases and hands-on labs.
whatYouWillLearn:
Identify and categorize chatbot use cases across industries
Map conversational flows and core components of chatbot architecture
Design and implement Dialogflow agents, intents, entities, and fulfillment logic
Develop Alexa Skills using AWS Lambda, DynamoDB, and the Alexa Development Console
Leverage contexts, follow-up intents, and non-linear flows for rich conversations
Integrate external services and deploy serverless functions for fulfillment
Work with Chatfuel’s architecture to build no-code bot flows and rich media responses
Test and simulate chatbots in Google Assistant and Alexa simulators
skills: Crafting conversation maps and user journeys
Configuring Dialogflow agents, intents, entities, and webhooks
Writing Node.js functions for AWS Lambda fulfillment
Managing AWS accounts, Lambda deployments, and DynamoDB persistence
Building interactive flows in Chatfuel with quick replies and blocks
Implementing conversational memory with contexts and follow-up intents
Testing and debugging bots in Dialogflow console and voice simulators
Deploying bots across multiple channels and monitoring performance

faqs.question: What is the “Know Your Future Managers” program about?
faqs.answer: “Know Your Future Managers” connects you directly with industry leaders—your potential future managers—who will provide tailored feedback and mentorship to help you secure roles in their organizations.

faqs.question: Who is eligible to enroll in the program?
faqs.answer: Anyone with the motivation to learn, grow, and upskill—regardless of background or prior experience.

faqs.question: Does my academic background affect my eligibility?
faqs.answer: Not at all. Our curriculum is designed for learners of all levels and does not require any specific degree or prior knowledge.

faqs.question: What happens if I change my mind after enrolling?
faqs.answer: You can request a full refund within 7 days of enrollment—no questions asked.

faqs.question: What is the duration of the program?
faqs.answer: Most cohorts run for 2–3 months. You also get a one-time 30-day pause option to accommodate your personal schedule.

faqs.question: Are the sessions delivered live or pre-recorded?
faqs.answer:
We offer a unique blend:
Pre-recorded video lectures you can revisit anytime
Scheduled live sessions with mentors for real-time interaction

faqs.question: Will the curriculum include real-world projects?
faqs.answer: Yes. You’ll complete multiple projects based on live data and real business challenges to build truly applicable skills.

faqs.question: How will the certification benefit my career after completion?
faqs.answer:
You’ll receive three key credentials:
Program Completion Certificate to validate your new skills
Internship Certificate to showcase hands-on experience
Letter of Recommendation highlighting your achievements

faqs.question: How will this program help me expand my professional network?
faqs.answer:
You’ll gain access to:
Our global alumni community
Industry professionals via forums, live Q&As, and networking events

faqs.question: What job-placement support do you provide?
faqs.answer:
Personalized referrals to five leading partner companies
LinkedIn and recruiter introductions to boost visibility
PPO consideration for top performers

faqs.question: What support is available if I encounter challenges during the program?
faqs.answer: 24/7 online chat support and phone assistance to resolve any technical or academic issues instantly.

faqs.question: Is there a dedicated success coach or mentor assigned to me?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every learner is paired with a dedicated mentor—each with at least 5 years of industry experience—to handle questions and guide you through the program.
